root_cause: NB1 constructs F4_SOURCE_FIELD from the maximum across eight signed 2D source-silhouette distance fields. E1/E2 extract that field directly; E3 also freezes its SDF/signs from build_field_npy(256) and optimizes lattice positions against the same source field.
retained_claims: E1 resolution behavior is evidence about marching-cubes discretization of the source-silhouette intersection field.
E2 MC-versus-regular-MTet is an extractor comparison on the source-silhouette intersection field.
E3 bounded lattice deformation is a deformation experiment on the source-silhouette intersection field.

The NB1 Stage13 apparatus uses exact admitted Knight source masks and cameras, but applying it to the source visual-hull-like field is not evidence that the learned IRIS field preserves the same geometry.
withdrawn_or_not_established: The learned IRIS field already contains the required detail and extraction/sampling is the only remaining owner.
MC is better than MTet for the learned IRIS field.
Bounded tetrahedral deformation fails to improve the learned IRIS field.
NB1 source-hull MC_R512 may be used as an oracle for learned-field certificate soundness.

existing_learned_field_baseline.interpretation: The learned field was already measured at R256 and is far below frozen Stage13-v2 source-correctness thresholds on overlapping metrics. The unresolved question is whether dense R512 evaluation materially changes that conclusion.
